sources.design: APx reports runtime separately from accepted output.
sources.text: The 3.1 workday figure uses summed agent runtime and an eight hour day. It is not a human productivity multiplier.
sources.title: Agent workdays are runtime

sources.design: Every APx score names a task family and reference cohort.
sources.text: Time horizons describe task difficulty at a stated success probability. They do not measure how long an agent ran or whether it can replace a job.
sources.title: Human time measures task difficulty

sources.design: Keep wall time, agent runtime, and human labor distinct.
sources.text: A followup productivity study identified selection bias and unreliable task timing when developers ran concurrent agents.
sources.title: The clocks get harder with concurrency

sources.design: Include review, repair, and integration before crediting output.
sources.text: GDPval evaluates work across 44 occupations using expert judging. Reported inference speed comparisons omit oversight and integration.
sources.title: Grade professional deliverables

sources.design: APx is a distinct measurement proposal, not Mercor’s APEX benchmark.
sources.text: APEX Agents provides 480 professional tasks with prompts, files, rubrics, and gold outputs.
sources.title: Work spans tools and applications

sources.design: Keep job, function, capability, and environment as separate tags.
sources.text: The occupational content model distinguishes tasks, work activities, context, skills, and abilities.
sources.title: Use a task taxonomy, not job stereotypes

sources.design: Require an independent acceptance gate beyond machine tests.
sources.text: A small study found that passing functional tests did not imply a change was ready to merge. Results were specific to its older model and tasks.
sources.title: Tests can miss real acceptance

sources.design: Safety failures block publishable scores. APx is not NIST certified.
sources.text: The voluntary AI risk framework supports contextual evaluation and trustworthiness across a system’s lifecycle.
sources.title: Protect evaluation integrity
